admin.title: Affiliate programme
admin.disabled_notice: The programme is off: referral links are not counted and no commission accrues. Turn it on under Settings.
admin.empty_text: Clients can open an affiliate account from the client area, or you can activate one from the client page.
admin.settings_lead: Cookie window, commission rate, clearance period and payout rules.
admin.self_signup: Clients may open an affiliate account themselves
admin.cookie_days_hint: An account opened within this many days of the click is credited to the affiliate (1–365).
admin.commission_hint: Product rates and per-affiliate rates take precedence over this default.
admin.recurring: Also pay commission on renewal invoices
admin.clearance_hint: Commission stays pending this long and is reversed on refund, chargeback or cancellation.
admin.min_payout_hint: Affiliates can request a payout once their balance reaches this amount.
admin.payout_manual: Manual payout (bank transfer etc., approved by staff)
admin.settings_invalid: Invalid settings: check the values (percent 0–100, periods positive, amounts zero or more).
admin.rates_lead: Commission different from the default for specific products; “No commission” excludes a product.
admin.rates_empty_text: Every product uses the programme's default rate.
admin.rate_add: Add or update a product rate
admin.rate_invalid: Invalid rate: a percentage must be 0–100 and a fixed amount zero or more.
admin.rate_delete_confirm: Return this product to the default rate?
admin.payouts_lead: Credit payouts are added to the account at once; approve manual payouts after you have paid them.
admin.approve_credit_confirm: The amount will be added to the affiliate's account credit. Continue?
admin.approve_manual_confirm: Confirm that you have made this payment? This cannot be undone.
admin.reject_confirm: Reject the request? The amount returns to the affiliate's balance.
admin.review_lead: Commissions of referrals that look like self-referrals wait for your decision.
admin.release_confirm: Release the held commissions into the normal flow?
admin.reverse_one_confirm: Reverse this commission? If it was paid out, it is deducted from the balance.
admin.overrides_hint: Empty fields use the programme default.

client.title: Affiliate programme
client.lead: Earn commission on payments of the customers you refer.
client.join_text: Share your personal link; you earn commission on paid invoices of customers who sign up through it.
client.closed: The affiliate programme is not accepting new members at the moment.
client.suspended: Your affiliate account is suspended; no new commission accrues. Open a ticket for details.
client.link_hint: Visitors who sign up through this link are credited to you.
client.payout_open: You have an open payout request; we will let you know once it is processed.
client.payout_not_yet: You can request a payout once your balance reaches the minimum payout.
client.details_hint: For a manual payout: IBAN, account holder and similar. Not needed for account credit.
client.payout_requested: Your payout request has been received.
client.referrals_hint: For privacy only the first name and last initial are shown.
